notes: Checked-in pronunciation dictionary for Happy Horse narration. The story on screen is never edited from this file. Only approved narration-alias rows are spoken differently. Pending rows are waiting for a person. Ambiguous personal names stay pending.

entries.notes: Personal name. Do not guess a pronunciation.
Personal name. Do not guess a pronunciation.
Fictional name. The alias is the pronunciation written for this character, not a guess about a real person. Local alias text works on eleven_v3. A server phoneme dictionary was not uploaded.
Fictional name with a regular English spelling. Leave the word as written.
Abbreviation expansion in the narration script.

entries.example: Mr. Bramble wore a soft scarf.

Say the full word so the letters are not spelled by accident.

entries.example: The postcard said U.S.A. on the stamp.
entries.notes: Letter-by-letter. The old cleanup used to insert a space after every period and split this acronym.

entries.example: They walked down St. Moon Lane.
entries.notes: Could mean Street or Saint. Do not guess.
Fictional place written with ordinary characters. eleven_v3 does not get a non-English phoneme dictionary from this app, so the characters stay as written.

entries.example: 故事裡的銀行只是一間小小的橡實店。
entries.notes: The full word 銀行 is the reading yín háng. Do not rewrite the single character 行, which is polyphonic.

entries.example: 快樂的樂和音樂的樂不是同一個音。
entries.notes: Polyphonic character. A single global reading would be a guess, so this row is reference only and is not substituted.
Polyphonic particle. Do not guess le versus liao, and do not rewrite every 了.
Fictional personal name using 單, which can be read more than one way. Pending human review. The shorter character 單 alone is not listed, so ordinary words are left alone.

entries.example: 他輕聲說 Happy，然後說晚安。
entries.notes: English word inside a Chinese sentence. Leave the Latin spelling. eleven_v3 can take a zh language code, but this app does not upload a mixed-language phoneme dictionary.
